# velin-copy

Copy text to clipboard (bridges to `<velin-copy>`).

## Values
| Value | Meaning | Bridges to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| (empty) | Copy host text content | `<velin-copy>` / Clipboard API |
| `selector` / value | Copy from related node when provided by enhance | Clipboard API |
## Example

```html
<div velin-copy>…</div>
```
